sources.topic: Masks/editing, static pane association, suspension snapshots and dictionary-backed entry/menus

contract.service: Explicit injected key events and headless controls; no host keyboard capture or native UI
contract.endpoints: KB:TPKB and combined WD:name/TPKB text FILEs; captured root pane, optional clipped echo, output/cursor/dictionary forwarding and no-echo intent
contract.editing: Bounded insert/delete/cursor and per-open-file history; termination priority, partial timeout results, finite per-call event processing
contract.waiting: Cooperative budgeted waits with captured scheduler clock or standalone logical sleeper completion; explicit-input indefinite standalone guard
contract.suspension: Snapshot existing matching reads only, pane/root-owned token IDs and nested POP; new reads unaffected; timeout continues during suspension
contract.controls: COMM/PROG or dictionary-alphabet entry with USER/USER2 gate; bounded subwindow/pull-up options and injected navigation
contract.persistence: Only unconsumed input, finite IDs, logical time and terminal history; reject open handles, pending reads and unpopped frames; no implicit input replay

boundaries: Portable key/mask/attribute/status codes, editing conventions and clock behavior rather than native controller encodings
No physical input, soft-key drawing/word cycling, generic keyboard FILE READ, binary/XML or byte queries
No restored active editors/clock links, form/table/list managers, strict/controller acceptance
